THE_ANSWER.question: do meok.ai and csoai.org truly work, matching what we say?
THE_ANSWER.MEOK: WORKS. Every route server-renders readable content — www.meok.ai 793-3,198 chars per page, os.meok.ai/arena 5,977. A crawler that executes no JavaScript sees the substance.
THE_ANSWER.CSOAI_human_surfaces: DO NOT WORK. Every one of 9 HTML routes tested returns HTTP 200 with 60 visible characters. The sitemap advertises 350 URLs and 10 of 10 sampled are content-free shells. csoai.org is instructing every search engine and AI retrieval system to index 350 pages that contain nothing.
THE_ANSWER.CSOAI_machine_surfaces: WORK, AND ARE HONEST. /api/tools returns application/json reporting total=7 tools across server_count=3 — which matches the independently measured census exactly (7 live tools, 3 servers). robots.txt and sitemap.xml serve correctly.
THE_ANSWER.THE_INVERSION: The API tells the truth and the website says nothing. For a measurement company that is a strange failure to have: the surface built for machines is accurate and the surface built for humans is empty. It also means the estate's honesty problem is NOT on csoai.org — there are no false claims there because there are no claims at all.
THE_ANSWER.why_UNBACKED_CLAIM_is_zero: This audit found ZERO unbacked numeric claims on csoai.org. That is not a pass. It is a direct consequence of the 9 INVISIBLE findings — a checker cannot find a false claim on a page with no text. The claim-checking arm of this audit is currently untestable against csoai.org and will only become meaningful once pages render.
THE_ANSWER.SOFT_404: csoai.org, www.meok.ai and os.meok.ai all return HTTP 200 for a path that cannot exist. Nothing is ever deindexed, and every stale link, typo and crawler probe looks valid. This affects BOTH estates, including the one that otherwise renders correctly.
